title: juncus drummondii var. parryi
intro: Juncus drummondii var. parryi, commonly known as Drummond's rush, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Juncaceae family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Drummond's rush include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Drummond's rush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
